task_definition.task_description: Please find me a good alternative in the audio category for the Sony XM5 headphones, then add the best recommendation to my cart with a quantity of 2. After that, check my available coupons, apply the best discount for those two items, generate a Stripe payment invoice for $718.20 and send it to customer@example.com, then back up the order workspace as invoice_backup_march, and finally tell me the current local time in New York.

user_input.query: For user_12345, please find me a good alternative in the audio category to the Sony XM5 headphones, specifically the product p_sony_xm5_blk. I need 2 total, and the items are [{ product_id: "p_sony_xm5_blk", quantity: 2 }], so please add the best recommendation to my cart with quantity 2. Then check my available coupons, including SAVE15, and apply the best discount for those two items. After that, generate a payment invoice for $718.20 and send it to customer@example.com. Please also back up my order workspace at /workspace/orders/user_12345 using the name invoice_backup_march, and finally tell me the current local time in New York using the America/New_York timezone.
